Title: Missing Help tooltip on Budget field
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Create New Task → 2. Hover over Budget input
Expected Behavior: Tooltip explaining minimum/maximum values, currency selection, and escrow fees.

Title: Inconsistent button labeling – Fund vs Add Funds
Reproduction Steps: 1. After creating a task note button label → 2. Navigate to Account > Wallet and see a different label for the same action

Title: No confirmation dialog when Canceling a task creation
Reproduction Steps: 1. Begin filling out a new task → 2. Click Cancel → 3. Task is discarded without warning
Expected Behavior: Prompt asking “Are you sure you want to discard this draft?” with Save Draft option.

Title: Broken link to Terms of Service in the footer
Reproduction Steps: 1. Scroll to bottom of any page → 2. Click Terms of Service
Expected Behavior: Direct to the correct TOS page.

Title: Unclear error message when uploading a file larger than allowed size
Reproduction Steps: 1. On Submit Work, attempt to upload a 50 MB file (limit assumed 25 MB) → 2. Observe generic “Upload failed” message
Expected Behavior: Show specific message: “File exceeds the maximum allowed size of 25 MB.”

Title: Lack of progress indicator during escrow funding
Reproduction Steps: 1. Click Fund Escrow, complete payment details → 2. No spinner or progress bar appears
Expected Behavior: Show a loading animation and status text (e.g., “Processing payment…”) until confirmation.
